{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|cooked monkfish|the raw form|raw monkfish}} {{Infobox Item |name = Monkfish |image = [[File:Monkfish.png]] |release = [[2 May]] [[2006]] |update = Return of the Wise Old Man! |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |edible = Yes |options = Eat, Drop |examine = A tasty fish. |value = 230 |weight = 0.400 |exchange = Yes |id = 7946 }} [[File:Monkfish detail.png|left|100px]] '''Monkfish''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 16 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking [[raw monkfish]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 62 [[Cooking]] and granting 150 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a [[burnt monkfish]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 90 on ranges and level 92 on fires. When eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat the monkfish. It heals some health.}} is displayed. While the [[Swan Song]] quest must be completed to fish raw monkfish, there is no such requirement for cooking them. Catching and cooking a monkfish is a requirement for the [[hard Western Provinces Diary]]. ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Cooking |skill1lvl = 62 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 150 |members = Yes |ticks = 1 |ticksnote = Increases to 4 when using an interface to select cooking option. |facilities = Cooking range |mat1 = Raw monkfish |output1 = Monkfish }} ===Cooking chance=== {{Skilling success chart|label=Monkfish cooking chance|showbefore=no |label1=Fire|low1=11|high1=275|req1=62|color1=orange|image1=Firemaking icon.png |label2=Range|low2=13|high2=280|req2=62|color2=saddlebrown|image2=Cooking range icon.png |label3=Gauntlets|low3=24|high3=290|req3=62|color3=grey|image3=Cooking gauntlets.png |label4=Hosidius +5%|low4=25|high4=292|req4=62|color4=red|image4=Cooking range icon.png |label5=Hosidius +10%|low5=38|high5=305|req5=79|color5=blue|image5=Cooking range icon.png |label6=Hosidius +5%, gauntlets|low6=36|high6=302|req6=62|color6=#ffcccb|image6=Cooking gauntlets.png |label7=Hosidius +10%, gauntlets|low7=49|high7=315|req7=79|color7=#ccccff|image7=Cooking gauntlets.png }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Cooking raw monkfish}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Monkfish}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Monkfish}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 24 July 2007 |update = King's Ransom |change = The item's inventory sprite was rotated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Monkfish detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Monkfish detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Monkfish (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Monkfish.png|center]] |- |2 May 2006 ⁠–
